catalogs.description: Workspace files holding catalogs beside the package manifests, relative to the workspace root

package.description: Installed package listing the versions it supports, resolved from the workspace root

file.description: JSON file inside that package, or inside its optional dependency installed for this platform

path.description: Keys from the file root to the object holding one key per supported version

supported.description: Pinned names, as a catalog or manifest spells them, whose moves stay among the versions an installed package lists in place of the dist-tag heads

dryRun.description: Prints each move and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

title: Upgrade
description: Moves every exact version a catalog or a package manifest of the workspace pins, npm: aliases included, to the newest of the package's undeprecated dist-tag heads, or of the versions an installed package lists for a supported name, among those published at or after the pinned version, ranked by release, then stable before prerelease, then publish time, ranges staying as floors, then installs and deduplicates to move the lockfile, then prunes the package manager's store
